launchTab.title: Open on the light meter
launchTab.body: Use Rollio mostly to meter? In Settings, set Open on Launch to Light Meter and the app starts there.

location.title: Save where you shot
location.body: Switch on Save Location on a frame to keep its GPS spot. It stays on for the next frames until you change it, shows as a pin on the roll, opens in your maps app, and goes into the CSV.

backup.title: Back up and restore
backup.body: Save every roll, frame and photo to a single file in iCloud Drive or Google Drive, and bring it all back on any phone.

export.title: Export a roll
export.body: Turn any film into a print-ready PDF contact sheet, or a CSV spreadsheet for your scans. Find it under Export in the film's menu.

settings.title: Settings tab
settings.body: A new home for your app language, backups and whatever comes next.
